intro: Poles love football, volleyball, ski jumping and speedway, and the country has produced stars from Robert Lewandowski to Iga Świątek.

chapters.title: Football and tennis
text: Robert Lewandowski is Poland's all-time top scorer and one of the best strikers of his generation. Poland finished third at the World Cup in 1974 and 1982 and co-hosted Euro 2012 with Ukraine.
Iga Świątek became world number one and has won several Grand Slam titles, including four French Opens and Wimbledon in 2025.

chapters.title: Volleyball, ski jumping and speedway
text: Poland's men's volleyball team won the world championship in 2014 and 2018, and matches fill huge arenas. Ski jumpers Adam Małysz and Kamil Stoch are national heroes; Stoch won three Olympic golds.
Speedway, motorbike racing on oval dirt tracks, draws big crowds, and Poland has the strongest league in the world. Hammer thrower Anita Włodarczyk won three Olympic golds.

keyTerms.meaning: Motorbike racing on an oval dirt track, with no brakes.
